newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS TRACE BUNDS TO WEAKER CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS TRACE BUNDS TO WEAKER CLOSE.

text.p: German Bunds inched lower and trade was livelier than on Monday
though the market was still in quiet summer mood, dealers said.
"Bunds simply reacted to slight profit-taking because the
German market was very thin," one dealer said.
"Generally the market is very technical at the moment. Bunds
have tried to break through a minor resistance at 102.93 today,"
he said. The yield gap over Bunds was seen steady around 30
The next domestic event is the 2006 auction on Thursday and
the next indicator is U.S. June PPI on Friday, dealers said.
